offering_description.value: Provides active, valuation-driven investment management to institutions, intermediaries and individual investors. It manages mutual funds, separate accounts and private funds, and also offers fund administration and model portfolio services.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; private investment funds; collective investment trusts; separately managed account strategies

primary_services.value: investment management; fund administration; model portfolio delivery; investment advisory

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutions, pension plans, endowments, foundations, financial intermediaries and advisors; B2C: individual investors, including high-net-worth clients, via funds and advisors

end_markets.value: asset management; wealth management; retirement plans; institutional investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: asset-based investment advisory fees on managed funds and accounts; service fees: fund administration and model portfolio fees; other: performance-based fees on some private funds and accounts
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees; other

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: manages client assets in equity and fixed income strategies for institutions, advisors and investors

geography_served.value: US national: Based in Columbus, Ohio, clients mainly across the United States, with some international institutional clients

specialization.value: related lines: equity, fixed income and alternative strategies, plus fund administration and model portfolios

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: institutional sales to pension plans, endowments and foundations; partners / resellers: financial intermediaries, advisors, wirehouses and retirement platforms distributing funds

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser and fund sponsor regulated by the SEC under the Investment Advisers Act and Investment Company Act
